The '''TranLang III communications module''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Communication module/Legends|communication module]] incorporating up to six million galactic [[Language/Legends|languages]] in its [[memory disc]]s.<ref name="Blueprints">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: The Ultimate Collection]]''</ref> The units were installed in [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]] and [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|LOM-series protocol droids]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

As well as common languages, the module's database included obscure dialects, [[Trade language/Legends|trade languages]], security codes, and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] transmissions. In addition, the TranLang III's phonetic pattern analysers made it capable of learning and translating unknown languages.<ref name="EGTD" />
